pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

Verdex is building a unified front door to tokenized markets—226 real-world assets across 12 issuers and 70 chains—with live Robinhood Chain indexes, stock-backed lending and 2× long/short leverage rather than just another portfolio dashboard. VERDEX is becoming the protocol’s discount and capture token: holders pay zero Index and Leverage fees, while fees from everyone else are intended to purchase VERDEX through a public treasury. 

The 10× case is straightforward from its roughly $100K–$150K valuation: successfully expand to Base and Solana, attract real basket/lending volume, and turn multichain fees into sustained Robinhood Chain buy pressure; its closest competitors are The Index and Factor for baskets and analytics, and Kamino/Aave for lending, but none currently combine discovery, indexes, recurring purchases, lending and leveraged stock trading in one interface. The next major checkpoint is the planned Base and Solana rollout around October 22, followed by completion of the remaining Phase 2 modules—but usage, fee-funded purchases and an external audit matter more than rapid feature releases because the new contracts are verified but currently unaudited.
